transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. Let's get started on the weekend shutdown planning. We've got the mandatory internal inspection of the central steam boiler coming up, which means we need to plan a shutdown affecting Lines 1 and 4. Saturday and Sunday are both available, but I haven't locked in the final outage window yet. Let's go around the room -- I want to hear from utilities, production planning, and safety before we finalize the schedule. Who wants to start?
